items.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is built for fast inference at scale, benchmarks show
items.content: Tested on SemiAnalysis’ InferenceX benchmark, Jalapeño registered both more tokens per user and more throughput per kilowatt than the currently available state-of-the art.
items.summary: OpenAI's Jalapeño chip delivers superior inference throughput and energy efficiency according to SemiAnalysis benchmarks.

items.title: Fusion Firm Gets Major Monetary Boost
items.content: Commonwealth Fusion Systems has raised around $4 billion in order to work toward commercializing fusion energy, that's about 30% of the total capital raised by the fusion industry to-date, according to CFS. In explaining on Bloomberg Businessweek what fusion is, the company's CEO Bob Mumgaard says the goal "is to build a machine that can make this reaction go at very vigorous amounts of energy at an industrial scale." (Source: Bloomberg)
items.summary: Commonwealth Fusion Systems raised roughly $4 billion, approximately 30% of total fusion industry capital, to advance commercial fusion energy.

items.title: FDA authorizes first wearable device that monitors ketone and blood sugar levels
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[madrox]: A friend died of diabetic ketoacidosis. He loved technology and seeing people succeed. Thinking of him with this news. Miss you Dan. Grateful we're moving forward on so many fronts in the world.

[ijustlovemath]: Automated glucose control will be the next frontier in so many areas of healthcare. I'm still skeptical that anyone will be able to noninvasively and accurately sense blood sugar, but I'm glad people (especially kids with T1) will have one more tool to help them. I hope they can figure out the reimbursement side to get it into the most hands possible!

[umvi]: Ketones are only going to be present if you are exceptionally bad (very high carb diet) or exceptionally good (very low carb diet) at managing your blood sugar. It's not going to be terribly useful for your average diabetic who has fairly good control over their blood sugars.

[nocodeexportcom]: What a remarkable legacy. I hope this technology helps prevent others from being lost to DKA. May Dan’s memory live on through the people he inspired and the communities he helped create.

[hacknews20]: Understanding why children's pancreases stop delivering insulin in the first place, which remains one of the big medical mysteries, would be a huge breakthrough for preventative medicine.
items.summary: FDA authorizes the first wearable device that continuously monitors both ketone levels and blood sugar, marking a significant step in diabetes management technology.

items.title: New Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[joshstrange]: Due to pricing insanity (not that Apple prices weren’t insane before the ram/ssd shortages) I’m not in the market but I do wonder if my next computer should be a Mac Studio instead of a MBP that lives its life docked. Might be better to just run a Studio and Neo for the very few times I actually need remote capabilities.

[osmukka]: Reading this press release was almost physically painful, because of how much Apple loves to use the phrase "up to". In total it appears  46  times.

[blints]: 10 grand for 256GB memory.  Likely double that for 512GB, but won't be available or finalized until October.  Thunderbolt 5 is highest bandwidth external IO available at 120Gb/s.  1.2TB/s claimed max internal memory bandwidth. Not exactly "future proof" for >1T parameter models but good for targeting specific lower-parameter models, or if you can rely on pipeline parallelism and run a cluster.

[doctoboggan]: > Apple’s most powerful Mac raises the bar for local AI Wow, "Local AI" mentioned in the subheading above the fold - it's really awesome to see Apple leaning into this use case and I think it will definitely pay off for them going forward. Fingers crossed Apple is able to put some engineering effort towards shipping with one of the frontier open weight models included and optimized exactly for the machine.

[GodelNumbering]: 1.2 TB/s bandwidth of M5 Ultra comes from two dies of M5 Max (each 614 GB/s) connected together using 4.4 TB/s inter-die fabric. For a non-quantized Deepseek V4 flash on an ultra, I would estimate about 1000+ tokens per second prefill and 50+ tokens per second on generation. This is actually quite usable and near parity to cloud. They mention "adds the GPU Neural Accelerators." which, if exploitable for LLM loads, would probably help the prefill a lot
items.summary: Apple announces the new Mac Studio featuring M5 Max and M5 Ultra chips, emphasizing high memory bandwidth and local AI capability.
